Snyder Chamber recognizes outgoing board member and highlights upcoming community events
The Snyder Chamber of Commerce thanks Jonathan Farmer for six years of board service. The Chamber also highlights ongoing community events, job opportunities, and ways for residents to get involved.
The Snyder Chamber of Commerce & Visitor Center has extended its appreciation to Jonathan Farmer, General Manager of United Supermarkets, as he concludes his six-year term on the Chamber Board of Directors. The Chamber acknowledged Farmer's commitment to supporting local businesses, building relationships, and investing in the community's future.
According to the Snyder Chamber of Commerce & Visitor Center, "Serving on a Chamber board is about more than attending meetings. It’s about investing in the future of our community, supporting local businesses, building relationships, and being willing to step up whenever help is needed. Jonathan has exemplified that commitment throughout his six years of service. Whether it’s lending a hand, offering support, helping with an event, or simply being someone we know we can count on, Jonathan has always been willing to jump in and help with anything and everything we need. His generosity, dependability, and willingness to serve have made a meaningful difference to our Chamber and the community we are proud to call home. As Jonathan’s time on the board comes to a close, we want him to know how much his dedication and contributions have meant to us. While he may be stepping out of his official board role, we hope he knows that his partnership and friendship will always be valued. Community leadership takes many forms, and we are grateful for the example he has set through his service and continued commitment to Snyder. Through his leadership at United Supermarkets and his involvement with the Chamber, Jonathan has demonstrated what it means to be a true community partner. We are fortunate to have businesses and leaders who believe in our hometown and are willing to invest their time and energy into making it a better place for everyone. Jonathan, thank you for six wonderful years of service, for always being someone we can count on, and for everything you do for Snyder and Scurry County! We sincerely appreciate you and wish you all the best as you move into this next chapter. You will always have our gratitude and support, and we look forward to continuing our partnership with you and United Supermarkets. From all of us at the Snyder Chamber of Commerce & Visitor Center, thank you for being part of our team and for helping make Snyder a great place to live, work, and do business!"
The Chamber also announced ongoing community events as part of the Smithsonian’s Museum on Main Street exhibition, Spark! Places of Innovation. The exhibition features hands-on demonstrations, local art, agriculture, STEM activities, oil and gas, rodeo traditions, entertainment, and food trucks. A special program about Quanah Parker, presented by Dr. Holle Humphries, will take place at the Scurry County Museum. Additional events include a movie screening at the Ritz Community Theatre and a local history program at the museum.
Local businesses and organizations are invited to participate in the annual Halloween in the Park event, which will be held at Heritage Village on October 30. The Chamber is also promoting job opportunities, including the weekly Walmart Snyder Job Fair, now held every Friday at 2 p.m.
The Snyder Gold Coats, ambassadors of the Chamber, continue to support community events such as the Western Swing Festival, sports tournaments, and ribbon cuttings. The group is seeking new members who are passionate about contributing to the community. For more information about joining or participating in Chamber activities, residents are encouraged to contact the Chamber staff or visit their website.
